verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a public Amazon SES API v2 reference. The SendEmail operation supports Simple, Raw/MIME and Templated messages, and the service can be called through AWS SDKs or directly via the API, with SMTP as an alternative. Probes confirm agent-friendly documentation: llms.txt and markdown versions of the docs are available. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths; API coverage of management operations (identities, configuration sets, receipt rules) is only implied, not cited from the API reference; and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
